standard_prerequisites.name: Term model definition
standard_prerequisites.use: The interpretation of constants and function symbols in M(Gamma*) that the induction reads off.

core_obligations: Statement: in the term model M(Gamma*), the value of every closed term t is t itself.

Proof (induction on t): the base case of a constant follows directly from the term model definition; for the step, Value(f(t1,...,tn)) equals the interpretation of f at the values of t1,...,tn, which by induction hypothesis are t1,...,tn, and the interpretation of f at closed terms is the term f(t1,...,tn) - displayed as an equality chain.
proof_roadmap: Start the induction at constants, where the definition applies directly.
At a function symbol, chain the interpretation clause with the induction hypothesis.
difficulty_reason: Term-value lemma (statement, proof lines 1230-1244): complete two-step induction with the displayed equality chain; nothing omitted. H2.
